property_summary: For every call, the callee must receive transferFrom selector arguments in the exact order (from, to, value), so a recording helper's decoded arguments must match c.transfer's from, _tos[i], and v; the mutant swaps to (from, value, to), which the same helper records as a mismatch.
change_summary: Swap the argument order in the external call to (from, v, _tos[i]) via abi.encodeWithSelector(id, from, v, _tos[i]).
